subject: Re: Thursday check-in time?
text:
Hi Professor,

Sorry if I jumped ahead a bit, but are we still moving Thursday to 3:30? I thought earlier it was 2:15, then you mentioned the lab could be free, and now I’m unsure if that means we still meet in your office or maybe the smaller room near the annex. I don’t want to miss it. If 3:30 is actually inconvenient because of your other class, we can keep the original time, and I won’t mind at all. I only asked because I need to coordinate childcare, and the timing helps me figure out bus transfers. Sorry again for mixing things up. I’ll check the calendar invite again, but if the invite hasn’t updated, could you send the corrected time? I might be confused, but I think the note from last week said “tentatively Thursday afternoon.” Thanks, and I hope this isn’t too much bother.

Best,
